import html # Predefined template for a blog post. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def show_blog_post(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Render a user‑submitted blog post safely for display in HTML. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title of the blog post. Must not be empty. text : str The body content of the blog post. Must not be empty. Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML string containing the blog post. Raises ------ ValueError If either `headline` or `text` is empty. """ if not headline: raise ValueError("headline must be a non‑empty string") if not text: raise ValueError("text must be a non‑empty string") # Escape user input to prevent XSS (CWE‑79) safe_title = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Return the formatted HTML return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
